subject.title: perf: measure and reduce the shared route entry bundle

question: Should ClawHub schedule this narrow route-entry A/B now, and what preload-byte or navigation improvement is material enough to expand it beyond the first route?
rationale: Source inspection supports the hypothesis, but selecting the performance threshold and deciding whether the measured benefit merits wider route refactoring require repository-owner intent.

options.title: Run the narrow A/B
options.body: Extract the legacy redirect and one detail-route data/head contract, then expand only after a material manifest and browser-navigation improvement.

options.title: Wait for shared benchmarks
options.body: Defer route changes until the broader performance effort establishes a reusable harness and accepted bundle budget.

recommendation.title: Run the narrow A/B
recommendation.body: Extract the legacy redirect and one detail-route data/head contract, then expand only after a material manifest and browser-navigation improvement.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the scoped investigation and related performance analysis and are best positioned to propose the initial threshold for maintainer confirmation.
